req.title: Login rejects wrong username
req.statement: The system shall render an 'Incorrect username.' error when the supplied username is not found.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-009 requires that POST /auth/login renders 'Incorrect username.' when the supplied username does not exist. Violations fixed: test[0] was kind=negative with heuristic=EP — negative tests must use heuristic=NEG, so changed to NEG. test[4] was kind=negative with heuristic=STC — STC is a structural/state heuristic valid for negative kind only when the rule allows it; since the rule flags it, changed heuristic to NEG for the negative kind. All other tests preserved exactly. Tests cover: (1) negative/NEG — wrong username triggers exact error; (2) positive/EP — valid credentials succeed with no error; (3) boundary/BVA — one-char-off username rejected; (4) negative/DT — wrong-username vs wrong-password produce distinct messages; (5) negative/NEG — session not set after wrong-username attempt; (6) boundary/BVA — empty username triggers error.

tests.name: test_login_wrong_username_shows_incorrect_username_error
preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded users (Rahul, Anjali, Ishaan, Diya, James)
Username 'NoSuchUser' does not exist in the database
expected: HTTP 200 (login page re-rendered, not a redirect)
Response body does NOT contain 'Incorrect password.'
trace: R-FLASKR-009: system shall render 'Incorrect username.' when username not found
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'NoSuchUser', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data, 'Expected Incorrect username. in response'
assert b'Incorrect password.' not in r.data, 'Did not expect Incorrect password. in response'

preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded users
expected: Response body does NOT contain 'Incorrect username.'
trace: R-FLASKR-009: error must NOT appear for a valid username — confirms the negative path is isolated
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/', f'Expected Location /, got {r.headers.get("Location")}'
assert b'Incorrect username.' not in r.data, 'Did not expect Incorrect username. in response'

tests.name: test_login_near_miss_username_one_char_off_rejected
preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded users
User 'Rahul' exists; 'Rahu' (one char shorter) does not exist
actions: POST /auth/login with username='Rahu' (one character removed from existing 'Rahul') and password='stone'
expected: Response body contains exactly 'Incorrect username.' — not 'Incorrect password.'
trace: R-FLASKR-009: boundary — username differing by one character from a real username must still be rejected with 'Incorrect username.'

tests.name: test_login_wrong_username_vs_wrong_password_different_messages

actions: POST /auth/login with username='GhostUser' and password='cloud' — username absent
POST /auth/login with username='Anjali' and password='wrongpass' — username present, password wrong

tests.name: test_login_wrong_username_session_not_set
preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded users
expected: Session cookie does NOT contain 'user_id' (user is not logged in)
trace: R-FLASKR-009: state transition — after wrong-username attempt the system must remain in the unauthenticated state (session not populated)
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

with client.session_transaction() as sess:
    sess.clear()

r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Phantom', 'password': 'river'})
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data, 'Expected Incorrect username. in response'

with client.session_transaction() as sess:
    assert 'user_id' not in sess, 'user_id must not be set in session after failed login'

tests.name: test_login_empty_username_shows_incorrect_username_error
preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded users
Empty string username does not match any user
actions: POST /auth/login with username='' (empty string) and password='stone'
expected: Response body contains 'Incorrect username.' (empty string is not found in DB)
trace: R-FLASKR-009: boundary — zero-length username is the minimum boundary; must still trigger 'Incorrect username.'
